new_results.statement: For every cap-one real density and 0<eta<1, sup_t E|U-t|^{-eta} <= 2^eta/(1-eta), hence E|2cU+gamma|^{-eta} <= |c|^{-eta}/(1-eta).

For Q=H^TCH+2H^T(BY+d+aU)+R(Y)+2cUV+beta U+gamma V+delta with H,Y,U,V source-disjoint original-coordinate groups, cap-one inputs, rank(B)=2, c!=0, and arbitrary measurable R(Y), Q has a continuous C0 density. For 1<r<=2, ||p_Q||inf <= C_ent,1(r) det(BB^T)^(-r/[4(2r-1)]) |c|^(-(r-1)/(2r-1)); at r=2 the constant is 9/(2*2^(1/3))<3.572.
The same scoped bound controls sup_{T,y} D_T law(Q)(y) by the account04/B01 signed-Fejer equivalence.

partner_result_applied.actual_inequality: Conditioning on U=u leaves an arbitrary-phase critical two-hub packet plus independent residual (2cu+gamma)V. The partner L^r theorem gives ||p_(Q|U=u)||inf <= A_r B_r^theta P^theta |2cu+gamma|^{-eta}; the cap-one fractional-pole lemma then integrates this uniformly.
